summary.intent: Plan and begin executing Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage), which adds cryptographic CBOR cid/sequence binding and a Rust verification chokepoint across 9 FUSE resolve sites plus symmetric JS binding in sdk-core.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves, 0 blockers) and Wave 1 execution began. Plan 58-01 completed after a crash+continuation cycle; plan 58-02 was spawned but the transcript ends before its result.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client or core, so Rust cross-language verify vectors must live in crates/fuse/tests/ rather than crates/crypto/tests/ to avoid a dependency cycle.
The local dev stack runs redis on :6380, api on :3000, postgres, and ipfs/kubo — all were up and usable for 58-02's full-SDK-E2E gate.
Plan 58-02's enforcement class (non-CAS embedded-sequence validation) previously broke 48 of 89 SDK E2E tests, making it the highest-risk plan in the phase.
9 FUSE resolve sites (events, fs, metadata, publish, replay, and others) needed routing through the new resolve_ipns_verified chokepoint; all were uncommitted when 58-01's executor crashed.
Phase 58 has TDD mode and fine granularity locked; VALIDATION.md frontmatter must be populated before planning proceeds (Nyquist enabled).
RESEARCH.md Open Questions sections must carry a '(RESOLVED)' marker on the heading or the plan checker flags a warning.

code.finding: ciborium was added as a dependency of the fuse crate; a mid-crash diagnostic falsely reported it missing (stale read during the executor's edit).
New file: resolve_ipns_verified wrapper that all FUSE resolve callsites must route through as the single verification chokepoint.
CBOR decode helper added here (RED→GREEN TDD), not in crates/fuse, because fuse has the dependency-cycle constraint.

workflow: The gsd commit helper returns commit_failed as a false negative; always verify actual commit state with git log rather than retrying on that signal.
Sequential execution on the feature branch was chosen over parallel worktrees for this phase — worktree parallelism introduces cwd-drift and merge failures on multi-crate security work.

When an executor dies mid-plan with uncommitted changes, a continuation subagent can be prompted with the precise uncommitted diff and remaining task list to resume cleanly without re-doing completed work.
AUTO_MODE=true means checkpoint gates (including non-autonomous plan checkpoints) are auto-handled as long as the required infrastructure is reachable.

friction: Plan 58-01 executor hit an API socket error (connection closed) mid-execution, losing its completion signal and leaving Task 3 done-but-uncommitted and Task 4 unstarted.
The gsd commit helper emitted commit_failed for the VALIDATION.md commit that actually landed — required a git log check to confirm and avoid a spurious retry.
A stale mid-edit read caused the crash diagnostic to report ciborium missing from crates/fuse even though it had already been written to Cargo.toml line 43.
open_items: Plan 58-02 (non-CAS embedded-sequence D-09 gate) was spawned but result not yet in transcript — has a human checkpoint at the full-SDK-E2E gate.
Wave 2 plans 58-03 (web/sdk-core resolve dedup, D-13) and 58-04 (shared cross-language verify vectors, D-11/D-12) not yet executed.

Cargo.lock is shown as a pre-existing modification throughout the session — not regenerated by release-please (known gap from prior memory); may need manual refresh after the cborg/ciborium dep additions land.
